# mymind

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 3 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Private-notes marketing: huge tight display type, one ember pill, blue text links, flat pastel cards on a warm paper page.

Captured 2026-11-21, signed out (public marketing pages only; the app at access.mymind.com was not entered). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for the public marketing site of mymind, a private bookmark and notes product. Captured from https://mymind.com/ on 2026-11-21, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440×900 and 390×844. One light theme. The signed-in app on access.mymind.com was not entered.

The public site paints a warm paper page (`#f9fafc`), black and near-black serif display type, and one ember accent (`#ff5924`) used as a pill fill. Links are `#1573dd`. Feature cards use flat pastels. There is no dark theme and no design-token layer: styles.css declares easing curves, and the colours below were read from computed styles.

## Typography

8 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Avenir LT W01_45 Book1475508, Inter-Regular, Louize-Regular-205TF, Nunito-SemiBold.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Avenir LT (fonts.net), Louize, Nunito and Inter are the product's faces. They are proprietary and are not in this package. Tokens name the computed family and a fallback. The style guide uses system fallbacks.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Pricing heading letter-spacing was not read and is omitted. FAQ line height repeats the 28px font size and is Derived. Nav line height uses the 24px box height because the computed line-height was 0px. Hover of the ember fill did not change; do not invent a hover ember. Focus ring width was not painted. Screenshots are 256-colour PNGs. Read colours from tokens.json.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do set display type huge and tight.** The home heading is 140px with -8.4px tracking. [screenshots/home-light-default.png](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
2. **Do spend ember on one pill.** The filled action is `#ff5924`. Other actions are blue links. [components/crops/button-signup-default.png](components/crops/button-signup-default.png)
3. **Do keep cards as flat pastels.** Feature tiles use sand, blue, green, blush and peach fills, not shadows. [screenshots/home-light-full.png](screenshots/home-light-full.png)
4. **Don't style the signed-in library from this package.** That surface is behind the auth wall and was not measured.
5. **Don't invent a dark theme.** The public site ships light only.
6. **Don't treat WordPress preset colours as the brand.** They are in the stylesheet and were not painted here.
